test_lacking_copy_ctor: test that objects lacking a copy constructor raise a RuntimeError when copied via pybind11
test_lacking_move_ctor: test that objects lacking both move and copy constructors raise a RuntimeError via pybind11
test_move_and_copy_casts: test pybind11 type casters and verify the number of move and copy operations during casting
test_move_and_copy_loads: test pybind11 argument loading via type casters and count move and copy operations
test_move_and_copy_load_optional: test move and copy loads of std::optional arguments through pybind11 type casters
